description: Your research group bulk-imported 25 biology and medicine papers into Zotero from multiple external databases. The import process introduced metadata corruption across multiple papers. Your task is to audit the entire library and fix every metadata error you find. The errors span at least three categories: incorrect publication years (where the stored year is inconsistent with when the work actually appeared), corrupted author names (where first and last name fields were transposed for the primary author), and placeholder abstracts that were never populated with real content. Find and fix all errors. The library is considered clean when every paper has a plausible publication year consistent with its subject matter, correct author name formatting, and either a real abstract or no abstract.
